## [1.9.8](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.9.7...v1.9.8) (2026-10-30)

## 🩹 What's new in v1.9.8

WaveFlow stays quiet when nothing is playing, and your ReplayGain and speed settings survive a restart.

---

### ⚡ Performance

- **WaveFlow no longer keeps your CPU and GPU busy when idle.** The logo in the sidebar pulsed in a loop that never stopped, even with playback stopped or the window minimised to the tray. On the reporter's system, that kept the WebView's GPU process at around 5 % CPU and 5 % GPU, and the cost grows with the display's refresh rate (144 Hz, 240 Hz). The logo is static now, and so is the small dot in the Home banner, which had the same endless pulse. ([#985](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/985))

### 🔊 Audio

- **The ReplayGain pre-amp, the fallback gain and the playback speed are saved again.** They applied during the session but reset to 0 dB and 1× on every launch: the database refused the way they were written, and the error was never shown. All three are now kept, and any setting that fails to save is logged. ([#984](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/984))

If you had set any of them, set them once more after updating; they will stick from now on.

---

## [1.9.4](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.9.3...v1.9.4) (2026-10-18)

## 🩹 What's new in v1.9.4

More reliable exclusive playback, FLAC files that end properly, and a way to keep the mini-player on top under Wayland.

---

### 🎧 Playback

- **No more crackling in exclusive mode while the interface is busy.** On Windows, with WASAPI exclusive output, opening the immersive view could make the sound crackle for a few seconds. The thread that feeds the device now runs as a Windows "Pro Audio" task, so it keeps priority over the interface. ([#889](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/889))
- **Following a track's sample rate no longer reopens the output twice.** With the output set to match each track's sample rate, WaveFlow could close and reopen the device twice at a track change. It now keeps the current output when it can, and reopens it only when the requested rate actually changes. ([#891](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/891))
- **FLAC files with a few stray bytes after their last frame now end normally.** Such a file played to the end, then showed "cannot play this track", and the queue stopped there. WaveFlow now treats it as the end of the track and moves on; a file that is really cut short is still reported. And pressing Play on a track that had stopped in its last two seconds now starts it over instead of failing again at the very end. ([#899](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/899), closes [#898](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/898))

### 📚 Library

- **The playing row turns green again after a double-click.** With double-click to play, the row you started stayed blue (selected) instead of green (now playing). Playing a row now clears the selection its own click made, in the library, album and playlist views. ([#900](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/900), closes [#897](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/897))

### 🐧 Linux

- **New setting: Run through XWayland.** Native Wayland does not give WaveFlow a reliable way to keep a window always on top or restore its absolute position, so the mini-player's pin and the desktop lyrics' placement may not hold. **Settings → Appearance → Player and window → Run through XWayland** restores those behaviours through X11 compatibility. It is off by default, since text can look slightly less sharp with fractional scaling, and takes effect at the next start. A `GDK_BACKEND` you set yourself still wins, and links opened from WaveFlow don't pass the setting on to your browser. ([#896](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/896), [#901](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/901), closes [#894](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/894))

name: v1.9.0
body: ## [1.9.0](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.8.4...v1.9.0) (2026-10-15) ## ✨ What's new in v1.9.0 **WaveFlow 1.9.0 — built around what you listen to.** Home now builds mixes from your favourite genres, decades and artists; mood radios listen to your corrections; your listens can go to ListenBrainz; and a long list of everyday details got faster to reach, from keyboard shortcuts to a sidebar that folds down to icons. Most of what is here was asked for by people using WaveFlow every day. Still local-first — online services stay optional. --- ### 🎧 Mixes made for you - **Genre, decade and artist mixes** join Daily Mix and On Repeat on Home: one mix for each genre and each decade you play most, and one for each of your top artists, built with the artists you listen to alongside them. ([#841](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/841), [#846](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/846)) - **A Daily Mix is no longer one artist on repeat**: each artist gets a fair share of the mix. ([#847](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/847)) - **Keep a mix** as a regular playlist before it refreshes, and **save the play queue** as a playlist in one click. ([#834](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/834)) ### 🌙 Mood radio that listens to you - **Sleep is quiet again.** Fast tracks misread at half speed no longer slip through, and tracks measured as loud are left out, so Sleep keeps to tracks that actually fit. ([#848](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/848)) - **Put a track into a mood, or take it out.** Right-click any track → Moods. Tracks you add come first; tracks you remove stay out. The sliders button next to Mood radio on Home lists your changes, one tab per mood, each one undoable. ([#849](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/849)) ### 📚 Library - **Several genres per track**, read from your files and written back by the tag editor. ([#840](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/840), closes [#729](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/729)) - **A Years tab**, grouped by decade, with a page for each year. ([#839](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/839)) - **"The Beatles" sorts under B.** Artists and albums are sorted without their leading article (The, Les, L'…). You can turn it off in Settings → Library. ([#838](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/838)) - **Tag edits stick.** A change of case or punctuation to an artist, album or genre now shows, and editing a track keeps its other credited artists. In the Flatpak, WaveFlow can now write to your Music folder. ## 🩹 What's new in v1.8.4

A patch for skins and the library: less memory pressure on Linux, stable album and artist covers on hover, clearer playlist cards and track lists, and album years that keep up with your tags.

---

### 🎨 Skins

- **A skin can no longer lock you out.** If WaveFlow closes unexpectedly on Linux while a non-Studio skin is active, the next launch opens in Studio, the safe baseline skin, and tells you why. A `--safe-mode` flag does the same by hand, and none of your other settings are reset. ([#823](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/823))
- **Lounge and Liquid use less memory on Linux.** The two glass-heavy skins could create very large compositing surfaces under WebKitGTK. WaveFlow now disables the most expensive fullscreen blur and continuous effects there, while keeping navigation surfaces opaque and readable. ([#820](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/820))

### 📚 Library

- **Album and artist covers stay still on Linux.** Moving the pointer over a cover could make the whole grid tremble under WebKitGTK. ([#825](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/825))
- **Playlist cards and track lists fit their skins.** In Pulse, Liquid and Lounge, playlist titles and counts now have room inside their cards, column resize handles no longer show as coloured squares, and hovering a track highlights that row instead of lifting the whole table. Selection stays visible in Lounge too. The track table also keeps its rounded corners in Studio, without clipping menus or losing its sticky header. ([#826](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/826))
- **Album years refresh when you rescan.** A year you had corrected, or one that was missing, did not always survive a rescan, and two tracks disagreeing on the year could flip it depending on scan order. ## [1.8.2](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.8.1...v1.8.2) (2026-10-05)

## 🩹 What's new in v1.8.2

A patch focused on correctness. Exclusive output is now truly bit-perfect, your listening history keeps the last song before you quit, accented names sort where you expect them, and lyrics apps on Linux can follow along again.

---

### 🎧 Audio

- **Exclusive output is now truly bit-perfect.** In exclusive mode (WASAPI on Windows, ALSA on Linux), every 16-bit and 24-bit sample came out off by one step from the file, so the stream was close to the original but not identical. It now matches the file sample for sample. macOS was not affected. ([#802](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/802))
- **The bit-perfect badge takes the volume into account.** Lowering the volume changes the samples, so the audio pipeline popover no longer calls the stream bit-perfect below 100 %. It shows a "volume" step instead. ([#802](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/802))

### 📚 Library

- **Accented names sort with their letter.** "Émilie Simon" used to land after "Zazie", at the very end of the list, while the A–Z rail filed her under E. Artists, albums, tracks and genres now sort with case and accents set aside, Czech, Romanian, Polish and Vietnamese letters included. A library that mixes local files and a WaveFlow Server also keeps both copies of an artist side by side. ([#805](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/805))
- **Shift+click works right after clearing a selection.** It used to select nothing until you clicked a first track again. ([#804](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/804))
- **A library created for you is named in your language**, instead of always "Ma musique". ([#804](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/804))

### 📊 Stats & history

- **The last song before you quit now counts.** A track you had been listening to for 15 seconds or more when you closed WaveFlow, or quit from the tray, never reached your history, your stats or Last.fm. It is now saved on the way out. ([#806](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/806))

### 🎤 Lyrics, playlists & radio

- **Unsynced LRC files show as plain lyrics.** Some LRC files stamp every line at the same time, often `00:00`. They were treated as synced, so the whole song sat on the first line. They now display as plain text. Enhanced LRC with word timings stays synced. ([#804](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/804))
- **Smart playlists left the "Add to playlist" menus.** A smart playlist rebuilds itself from its rules, so a track added by hand disappeared at the next refresh. Only regular playlists are offered now. ([#804](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/804))
- **Offline radio tags with `%` or `_`** now match literally instead of acting as wildcards. ([#804](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/804))

### 🐧 System integration

- **`playerctl position` follows playback on Linux.** The position WaveFlow reports to MPRIS stayed frozen at the start of the track, so lyrics apps such as sptlrx never moved. It now updates every second while playing. ([#807](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/807))

### ⚡ Performance

- **Smoother while playing.** The playback position updates four times a second, and each update used to redraw the whole interface, the library included. Now only the parts that show the position redraw. ([#809](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/809))

body:
## [1.8.0](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0) (2026-09-30) ## ✨ What's new in v1.8.0 **WaveFlow 1.8.0 — every word, every detail.** Lyrics now follow you everywhere, highlighted word by word and floating on your desktop; exclusive output now works across Windows, Linux and macOS; your playlists take their colours from their covers; and WaveFlow talks to the rest of your setup, from MPD clients to your own server. **Our biggest release yet: 119 issues closed**, most of them reported by people who took the time to tell us what they hit. Still 100% local-first. --- ### 🎧 Your audio hardware, properly used - **Exclusive output on all three systems** — WASAPI on Windows, ALSA on Linux, CoreAudio on macOS. WaveFlow can take the sound card for itself, for ordinary playback as well as DSD. - **DSD over PCM (DoP)** sends the original DSD stream to a compatible DAC without converting it to PCM first. It ships **switched off** — turn it on under Settings → Playback and audio if you own the hardware. - **The output device menu tells the truth**: what each device actually accepts, and which one really opened rather than the one that was asked for. When playback has to drop out of exclusive mode, you are told. - **ReplayGain, done properly** — album gain, a pre-amp, a fallback level for untagged tracks, and clipping prevention, all adjustable. - **Opus and AIFF are now supported.** - **WaveFlow remembers where you were**: the resume point is saved on exit and as you listen.
### 🎤 Lyrics, everywhere you look - **Floating desktop lyrics** — a window that sits above everything else, so the words are there while you work. Resizable from any side, one line or two. - **Karaoke that highlights word by word**, and when a provider only gives line timings, WaveFlow estimates the timing of each word itself — so the karaoke runs on almost any synced lyrics. - **Lyrics in the mini-player** too, with the same word-by-word karaoke as the immersive view, the lyrics panel and the floating window. - **Romanization** puts a readable line under Japanese, Korean and Chinese lyrics, and **translations** sit alongside the original. - **Backing vocals, duets and instrumental breaks** — backing vocals sit under the line they belong to, the second voice of a duet answers from the other side, both lines stay lit while two voices overlap, and three dots breathe through the instrumental parts. - **Held notes ripple** through their letters in the immersive view, stronger the longer the note is held. You can switch it off. - **Pick a lyrics plugin by hand** from the lyrics source menu, and plugins now get the album, the track's length and its ISRC, so they find the right recording rather than a namesake. - **A colour for the line being sung** — one of eight pastels, or a rainbow that moves to the next colour with every line. - **Calmer on the network**: a track with no lyrics stops re-searching every time you open it, you can switch off any provider you don't want, and whole genres can be skipped.
### 🎨 Your library, brought to life - **Playlists take their colour from their cover** — the header is built from the artwork, or you pick the colour yourself and it stays. - **Canvas** plays a short looping clip in place of the cover while a track is on, in a frame shaped for it. - **The immersive view** puts it all together: artwork, clip, and lyrics synced to the word. - **Artist pages** get a full-width backdrop you can choose. - **The mini-player** keeps up with all of it: Canvas clips, the cover slideshow, and a volume slider with mute. - **A high-contrast mode** that works across every theme and skin.
### 🔌 It talks to the rest of your setup - **MPD server** — drive playback from the MPD clients you already use. Off unless you turn it on. - **Plugins** — an in-app store with verified installs. **Release Radar** finds recent releases from the artists in your library, **Apple Motion Artwork** and **TIDAL Artwork** bring animated covers, **BiniLyrics** adds word-by-word lyrics with backing vocals and duets, and **Web Radio** carries 30 000+ stations. - **A WaveFlow server**, if you run one, now merges its catalogue into your library: browse both from one list, keep a track on disk, or import it. ### ▶️ Playback - **Album shuffle** shuffles whole records, and Mood radio and Daily Mix can build their sessions out of whole albums. - **Mood radio** ranks tracks by how well they fit the mood. - Playback buttons under the **Windows taskbar thumbnail**. - Playing a track from your **history** queues the ones after it too, and **single-click play** no longer restarts the track on a double-click. ### 📚 Library - **Browse by folder**, and find Chinese titles by their **pinyin**. - A **"Needs attention"** tab for tracks missing something. - Find artists that are really **several names joined by commas**, and split them. - **Tag editing that is safe for your files**, and now reaches DSD. - **Star ratings** reach your files reliably, ID3v2 included, and the tag editor **suggests values** as you type. - **Smart playlists**: ten new rule types, relative time windows, and a live count while you build. - **Artist pages list every track the artist is credited on**, features included, and an artist who only appears as an album artist ("Various Artists") gets a page too. - A **rescan keeps each album with its album artist**: a compilation, or an album with an explicit album artist, is no longer handed to whichever track was rescanned first. ### 🖥️ Interface - **Settings reorganised**, with a search box, and switches instead of tick boxes. - **Back and forward** remember where you were. - A **native-looking window frame** on Linux and macOS. - A **cover slideshow** behind the now-playing view. - A **radio station** fills the immersive view with its artwork. - A switch to **hide animated covers** altogether. - **Put the mini-player back** to its default size and corner from Settings, or by double-clicking its drag handle. - **On from the start**: the lyrics column in the immersive view, and the spectrum visualizer, now in rainbow. If you had set them yourself, your choice stays. ### 🛠️ Reliability - A launch that never paints anything **falls back to software rendering** on its own next time. - **Switching profiles** no longer inherits the previous profile's audio settings. - A setting you change **reaches every window**. - A plugin that cannot load **says so** instead of failing silently. - After an automatic crossfade, **lyrics and the progress bar** no longer run a few seconds behind the music. - An album's **embedded cover** follows its first track. - A **motion cover you set by hand** now shows during playback. - On Linux, **animated covers now play**, and the AppImage no longer rescans its video plugins at every launch. - On Linux, the **immersive view no longer blacks out** when an animated cover appears, and the output device you picked is **found again at launch**. - The exclusive-output switch shows **what you chose**, even when the device refused it. - A sound device that keeps failing **no longer fills your disk with logs or keeps a CPU core busy**: WaveFlow steps back and retries less and less often. Logs are kept seven days, 50 MB a day at most. - **Your library is copied before every database upgrade**, and the last three copies are kept. - On Windows, a **minimised or hidden window gives memory back** while the mini-player plays. - The **AppImage opens folders and links** again. - A **profile backup imports** even while the profile it came from still exists, under a free name — and export and import say they are running. ### 🌍 Languages - **All 17 languages were reviewed line by line**, five of them — Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean and German — by native speakers. - Several hundred strings changed: wording translated too literally, terms that did not match between screens, and a few sentences that said the opposite of the English. ### ⚠️ One removal: the Spotify integration **It is gone.** It needed you to register a developer application before anything worked, it was unreliable, and very few people ever got that far. - If you had connected an account, the stored token is **deleted when you update** — there is nothing for you to do. - **Daily Mix** and **On Repeat** are WaveFlow's own and stay, and Canvas clips never depended on it. --- ## 📦 Recommended install Use your platform's package manager when one is available, so updates keep flowing through the tool you already use. ### Windows ```powershell winget install InstaZDLL.WaveFlow ``` ### Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS / CachyOS ```bash yay -S waveflow-bin # or: paru -S waveflow-bin ``` ### Fedora / RHEL / Rocky / Alma / CentOS Stream ```bash sudo dnf copr enable instazdll/waveflow sudo dnf install waveflow ``` ### Debian / Ubuntu / Mint / Pop!_OS The Debian package is `wave-flow` (kebab-case, required by the Debian naming spec — Tauri bundles it that way from the `WaveFlow` product name). ```bash sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://packages.buildkite.com/instazdll/waveflow/gpgkey \ | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/waveflow.gpg echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/waveflow.gpg] https://packages.buildkite.com/instazdll/waveflow/any/ any main" \ | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/waveflow.list sudo apt update && sudo apt install wave-flow ``` ### macOS No Homebrew cask yet — grab the `.dmg` below. The bundle isn't Apple-signed, so right-click → Open the first time, or run `xattr -cr /Applications/WaveFlow.app` to clear the quarantine flag. ### Standalone download Everything is also available as a raw bundle below — `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.exe`, `.msi`, `.dmg`. --- _Thanks to everyone who tested betas and sent feedback — it shaped a lot of this release. 💚_

name: v1.8.0-beta.3
body:
# WaveFlow 1.8.0-beta.3

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** If you are already on a 1.8.0 beta you will get this automatically. Coming from 1.7, turn on **Settings → Diagnostics → Beta channel**; once you are on 1.8 the switch lives under **Settings → Maintenance → Updates**. Stable users are unaffected.

**A short one, cut quickly because your reports kept coming.** Everything here answers something a tester ran into on beta.2 — plus a full read of every translation before the stable release.

## 🎤 Lyrics

- **A colour for the line being sung**, in the full-screen lyrics and the mini-player: eight pastels picked to stay readable on those dark surfaces, and a **rainbow** mode that gives each line the next one. Settings → Images and lyrics → Sung line colour. High contrast still keeps it white. ([#751](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/751), [#753](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/753))
- **Estimated word-by-word karaoke keeps up with the voice.** Words used to be spread all the way to the next line, so they trailed further behind as the line went on. ([#750](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/750))

## 🖼️ Artwork

- **The artist banner suggestions work.** Picking one failed with a database error; only a local file got through. ([#750](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/750))
- **A cover you change inside your files now reaches the album** on the next scan, instead of the album keeping the old picture. A cover you chose yourself, or one found in the folder, is never replaced that way. ([#750](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/750))
- **Dark covers no longer have pale corners.** ([#750](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/750))

## ✨ Interface

- **The immersive view's tabs stay on the buttons' line** and keep their labels whenever there is room — round icons only when there is not. They used to drop below the buttons and push the lyrics down the screen. ([#750](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/750))
- **"Software rendering is on" no longer appears for nothing.** Opening WaveFlow twice in quick succession — a double click is enough — made the second launch mistake the first one, still starting, for a launch that had failed to draw, and it switched to software rendering and stayed there. If you saw that banner without a reason, **Settings → Maintenance → Diagnostics → Try the GPU again** puts you back. ([#755](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/755))
- **The home greeting has an afternoon.** It said "Good morning" until 6 pm.
- **Discord Rich Presence stops filling the log** with one warning per track when Discord is not running.

## 🌍 Translations

**All 17 languages were read in full, key by key**, against the English and the French: meaning, formal or informal address, the same word for the same thing, and typography. About 1,150 strings changed. A few of them were plainly wrong — in Arabic, the arrows on the sync buttons pointed the opposite way to the copy they perform; in Japanese, "Play next" read as "play the next track"; in Russian, a rule on the last 21 days read as "the last day". ([#754](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/754))

If you use WaveFlow in a language other than English, **this is the build to look at**: a wording that feels off to a native speaker is worth a report.

## 📝 Notes for testers

Everything on the earlier lists still stands — **exclusive output**, **native DSD (DoP)** on a real DAC, and **tag editing on copies of your files** remain the most valuable reports.

**New this round:**

1. **The sung line colour**, in the full-screen lyrics and the mini-player, rainbow included.
2. **The immersive tabs** at your screen size, in your language — the labels are measured, so a longer translation is the real test.
3. **Your language**, anywhere you spend time in the app.

**What I need in a report:** your OS, the exact steps, and your logs — **Settings → Maintenance → Diagnostics → Copy logs** puts them on your clipboard, ready to paste.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.8.0-beta.2...v1.8.0-beta.3

body:
# WaveFlow 1.8.0-beta.2

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** If you are already on 1.8.0-beta.1 you will get this automatically. Coming from 1.7, turn on **Settings → Diagnostics → Beta channel**; once you are on 1.8 the switch lives under **Settings → Maintenance → Updates**. Stable users are unaffected.

**This beta is almost entirely your doing.** Twenty-seven issues closed since beta.1, and most of them came from people running it and writing down what was wrong. A few were things I would never have found alone — the mini-player showing no Canvas, the folder toggle that did nothing in a folder with no subfolders, a right-click that opened the browser's menu instead of the app's.

If beta.1 was about the audio engine, this one is about everything you touch.

## 🎨 Playlists

- **A playlist header built from its cover.** The header now takes its colour from the artwork instead of sitting on a flat surface, in a gradient that reads as part of the picture. A playlist can also keep a colour you pick yourself — the auto / manual choice is in the playlist's edit dialog, and it is remembered per playlist. ([#732](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/732))
- **Right-click a playlist and you get WaveFlow's menu**, not the webview's. Play, shuffle, play next, add to queue, rename, change the cover, delete — with a confirmation before a delete. It works in the sidebar, on the grid, and on the pinned **Liked tracks** and **Recently played** rows. ([#737](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/737))
- **Shuffle play no longer turns shuffle off** when it was already on.

## 🎤 Lyrics

- **The floating lyrics window behaves.** It can show a single line instead of two, it widens from either side rather than only one, and the corners resize properly. ([#735](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/735))
- **Word-by-word karaoke on line-synced lyrics.** When a provider gives only line timings, WaveFlow can estimate where each word falls. **Opt-in, and never written to your files or your database.** ([#716](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/716))
- **A track with no lyrics stops re-searching every time you open it.** One provider failing used to override the cached "nothing found", so the whole chain ran again on every single open. ([#720](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/720))
- **Switch off any online provider**, not just one of them, and **skip the online search entirely for genres you choose** — instrumental and lo-fi are skipped by default. ([#722](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/722), [#721](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/721))
- **A skipped track now says it was skipped**, rather than reporting that nothing was found. ([#731](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/731))

## 🎬 Now playing and the mini-player

- **The spectrum visualizer, rebuilt.** Curves instead of plain bars, twelve bass bands that no longer share six FFT bins, and bars that actually reach the top. ([#699](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/699), [#715](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/715))
- **Canvas gets its own tall frame** instead of being squeezed into the square cover, which was cutting about 44 % of the clip's height. ([#694](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/694))
- **The mini-player catches up**: the cover slideshow runs there too, its lyrics overlay was reworked, and it now shows Canvas and animated covers. ([#702](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/702), [#697](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/697), [#717](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/717))
- **Closing the mini-player and reopening it works** — it used to come back to a window that was no longer there.
- **The slideshow uses your local artist images**, not only what Deezer has. ([#701](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/701))

## 👤 Artists and library

- **Picking a different artist in the image picker now re-links the artist**, instead of changing only the photo and leaving the biography, the fans and the similar artists pointing at the wrong person. ([#692](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/692))
- **The artist backdrop can be chosen**, and is no longer a low-quality crop through someone's face. ([#693](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/693))
- **Find artists that are really several names joined by commas**, and split them from there. ([#719](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/719))
- **Splitting an artist reaches the window you are looking at**, instead of leaving the panel resolving an id that no longer exists. ([#713](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/713))
- **Lyrics, Canvas clips and animated covers stay next to the music** they belong to. ([#695](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/695))
- **The track properties dialog suggests tags** as you type — artists, albums and genres from your own library.

## ✨ Interface

- **Every on/off row in Settings is a switch**, not a tick box. ([#738](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/738))
- **The folder grid/list toggle does something** in a folder with no subfolders, instead of being a pair of dead buttons. ([#739](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/739))
- **Back and forward return you to the library tab you were on.** ([#745](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/745))
- **The now-playing handle stays reachable** while the lyrics or the queue are open, so you can get back to the artwork without closing the panel first. ([#747](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/pull/747))
- **The track information dialog opens properly from a playlist.** Its backdrop covered only part of the page and the dialog sat off-centre.
- **A native-looking window frame on Linux and macOS**, as a choice. ([#696](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/696))

## ⚙️ Settings that cross windows

**A preference you change now reaches every window.** The mini-player and the lyrics overlay are separate windows, and a setting changed in the main one never got to them — they kept the old value until you closed and reopened them. This was never about one setting; it was every preference those windows read. ([#741](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/741))

**Switching profiles no longer inherits the previous profile's audio settings** — the visualizer, EQ, speed and crossfade of the profile you left were staying behind. ([#698](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/698))

## 🔌 Plugins

- **A plugin that cannot load is now visible.** It used to fail silently: nothing at install, no state in the list, no cause in the message. It is now refused at install, shown as broken, and told to you with the reason. ([#708](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/708))
- **Two plugins published** since beta.1 and installable from the store: **Release Radar**, which finds recent releases from the artists in your library, and an update to **Apple Motion Artwork**.

## 📝 Notes for testers

Everything on the beta.1 list still stands — **exclusive output**, **native DSD (DoP)** on a real DAC, and **tag editing on copies of your files** are all still unconfirmed on hardware I do not own. Those remain the most valuable reports you can send.

**New this round, in order:**

1. **The playlist headers, in a light theme and in the Liquid skin.** This is colour generated from your covers, so it meets artwork I have never seen. If a header ever makes its own text hard to read, that is a bug and I want the cover.
2. **The right-click menu everywhere it appears** — sidebar, grid, and the pinned Liked tracks / Recently played rows.
3. **Cross-window settings.** Open the mini-player, change a setting in the main window, and check it follows without reopening anything.
4. **Estimated word-by-word karaoke**, if you use lyrics. It is off by default and it is a guess — tell me where the guess is bad.
5. **The floating lyrics window on Wayland**, still.

**What I need in a report:** your OS, the exact steps, and your logs — **Settings → Maintenance → Diagnostics → Copy logs** puts them on your clipboard, ready to paste.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.8.0-beta.1...v1.8.0-beta.2

name: v1.8.0-beta.1
body:
# WaveFlow 1.8.0-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** To get it from 1.7, turn on **Settings → Diagnostics → Beta channel**; once you are on 1.8, the switch lives under **Settings → Maintenance → Updates**. Stable users are unaffected.

This is the **first beta of the 1.8 cycle**, and it is a big one: it carries everything merged since 1.7.0, almost two months of work. The headline is audio output — exclusive mode now reaches Linux and macOS, and native DSD arrives on all three systems — but tag editing, ReplayGain, lyrics and the library have all moved a long way too.

Because so much changed at once, the **Notes for testers** at the bottom matter more than usual. If you only have ten minutes, start there.

## 🎧 Audio output

- **Exclusive output on Linux and macOS**, not just Windows. WaveFlow can now take the sound card for itself on all three systems — ALSA on Linux, CoreAudio on macOS — and not only for DSD: for ordinary playback too.
- **Native DSD via DoP** (DSD over PCM). Instead of converting DSD to PCM, WaveFlow can send the DSD stream as-is to a DAC that understands it. **Off by default** — see the tester notes, because this one needs your hardware. ([#495](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/495))
- **Follows your system's default output device** when you have not pinned one, instead of staying on the device that was default when the app started. ([#627](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/627))
- **Plays each track at its own sample rate**, when you ask it to, rather than resampling everything to one rate.
- **The output device menu tells the truth.** It now shows what each device actually accepts, and reports the device that really opened — not the one that was asked for. ([#612](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/612))
- **A silent fallback is no longer silent.** When playback has to drop out of exclusive mode, or falls back in any other way, you now get told instead of the change only reaching the log.
- **Losing a device is handled better**: a paused session stays paused, rather than resuming on whatever output is left. ([#611](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/611))

![The output device menu listing each device with the formats it actually accepts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/fe108af5a3475c0a943c8d4ab888d1c7409f8dde/docs/screenshots/output-devices.png)

## 🔊 Playback

- **ReplayGain, brought up to the standard.** Album gain, a pre-amp, a fallback level for untagged tracks, and clipping prevention — all adjustable. R128 tags are now read from your files, and loudness analysis follows ITU-R BS.1770-4.
- **Album gain applies when a whole record plays through**, and **album shuffle** shuffles whole records instead of individual tracks. ([#587](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/587), [#618](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/618))
- **Opus** and **AIFF** files now play. ([#581](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/581))
- **WaveFlow remembers where you were.** The resume point was, in practice, never written — it is now saved on exit and every ten seconds, including when playback is started from MPD or your system's media controls. ([#624](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/624), [#609](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/609))
- **Clicking quickly no longer plays the wrong track.** A slow-to-prepare track could overwrite a newer choice; the most recent one you asked for now always wins. ([#622](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/622))

## 🎤 Lyrics

- **A floating desktop lyrics window** that sits on top of everything, karaoke-style. Turn it on from **Settings → Appearance**. ([#582](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/582))
- **Lyrics in the mini-player.** ([#580](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/580))
- **Progressive karaoke fill** on the word being sung, instead of the whole word lighting up at once. ([#491](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/491))
- **Lyrics plugins can now provide word-level timing**, and a romanization or translation under each line. ([#585](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/585))

![The floating desktop lyrics window over the desktop, mid-song](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/fe108af5a3475c0a943c8d4ab888d1c7409f8dde/docs/screenshots/desktop-lyrics.png)

## 📚 Library

- **Choose, reorder and resize the columns** in track lists. Columns that do not fit now hide instead of making the page scroll sideways. ([#588](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/588))
- **Browse by folder**, and **find Chinese titles by their pinyin** — or just by the initials. Search also matches the middle of a title now, not only the start. ([#578](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/578), [#579](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/579))
- **A "Needs attention" tab** that lists what is wrong with your library in one place: missing covers and tags, albums whose tracks disagree on the year, duplicate track numbers, gaps in the numbering. ([#589](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/589))
- **One status bar for long-running tasks**, with a cancel button, instead of each task reporting in its own corner. ([#601](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/601))
- **Smart playlists** gain more rule fields, a live count of matching tracks as you edit, ready-made templates, and a plain-language summary of what a rule does. ([#591](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/591))
- **Mood radio** is ranked by how well each track fits, and album tags can be fetched online for you to review before they are written. ([#616](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/616), [#599](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/599))
- **Choose where artwork and caches are stored.** ([#619](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/619))
- **Rescan the whole library in depth**, not one folder at a time — which also picks up tag changes a normal rescan could miss. ([#457](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/457))

![The Needs attention tab listing the library's problems by category](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/fe108af5a3475c0a943c8d4ab888d1c7409f8dde/docs/screenshots/needs-attention.png)

## 🏷️ Tag editing — safer

**Editing a tag could damage the file it was editing.** If a write was interrupted at the wrong moment, the original could be left truncated. That is fixed at the root: edits now go into the free space already reserved inside the file wherever possible, a write survives an interruption, and one file is only ever written by one writer at a time. The same editor now reaches **DSD (DSF) files** too. ([#590](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/590), [#592](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/592), [#598](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/598))

Along the way: star ratings reach ID3v2 files again, and the year is written where older ID3v2.3 readers actually look for it.

## ✨ Interface

- **Settings, reorganised** into categories with a searchable sidebar.
- **A high-contrast mode** that works across every theme and skin. ([#596](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/596))
- **Windows: playback buttons under the taskbar thumbnail.** ([#583](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/583))
- **A full-bleed backdrop behind the artist page header.** ([#482](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/482))
- **A per-track Canvas** — a short looping video that takes the cover's place while the track plays — and a crossfading slideshow between the cover and the artist. ([#442](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/442), [#466](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/466))
- **Pick the spectrum visualizer's colours**, and a **volume slider in the mini-player**. ([#468](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/468), [#511](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/511))

![The immersive view: a track's Canvas video looping beside lyrics synced word by word, with a romanization under each line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/fe108af5a3475c0a943c8d4ab888d1c7409f8dde/docs/screenshots/immersive.gif)

## 🖥️ Startup

- **If a launch never paints anything**, typically a graphics driver problem, the next launch falls back to software rendering on its own instead of opening to a blank window again. ([#595](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/595))
- **Opening a library made by a newer version** now explains what happened, instead of stopping on the splash screen. ([#526](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/526))

## 🔌 Plugins and connections

- **MPD server**: existing MPD clients on your network can now drive playback. Off unless you turn it on. ([#471](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/471))
- **Plugin descriptions and options are translated** into your language. ([#440](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/440))
- **If you run a WaveFlow server**, its catalogue now merges into your library: browse both sources from one list, keep a server track on disk, import one into a scanned folder, and correct its tags without touching a file.

## 🌍 Languages

**All 17 languages were reviewed by native speakers**, and several hundred strings changed as a result — wording that was translated literally, terms that did not match between screens, and a few sentences that said the opposite of the English. ([#670](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/670))

## ⚠️ Removed: the Spotify integration

**The Spotify integration is gone in this release.** It needed you to register a developer application before anything worked at all, it worked unevenly, and very few people ever got that far. ([#680](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/680))

If you had connected an account, the stored token is deleted when you update — you don't need to do anything. Nothing else changes: **Daily Mix** and **On Repeat** are WaveFlow's own playlists and stay, and per-track Canvas videos never depended on the integration.

## 📝 Notes for testers

**Most wanted, in order:**

1. **Exclusive output on Linux and macOS.** This depends entirely on your hardware and I could only test a few setups. Pick your DAC in the output device menu and check that playback starts, that the sample rate shown matches the file, and that switching tracks at different rates works.
2. **Native DSD (DoP)**, under **Settings → Playback and audio**. **This has never been confirmed on a real DoP-capable DAC**, which is exactly why it ships switched off. If you own one, please turn it on, play a DSF or DFF file, and tell me whether your DAC shows DSD — or PCM, or noise.
3. **Tag editing on your own files.** The rewrite is designed to be safer than before, but it is new code writing to your files. **Try it on copies first**, especially FLAC, MP3 with ID3v2 and DSF.
4. **The resume point.** Close WaveFlow mid-track and reopen it: it should come back to the same track and position.
5. **The desktop lyrics window on Wayland**, if that is your setup.

**What I need in a report:** your OS, the exact steps, and your logs — **Settings → Maintenance → Diagnostics → Copy logs** puts them on your clipboard, ready to paste.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0-beta.1

body:
## [1.7.0](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0) (2026-07-26) ## ✨ What's new in v1.7.0 **WaveFlow 1.7.0 — living artwork & extensibility.** Album covers now come alive with Apple-Music-style motion art, a new in-app **plugin store** lets you add features in one click, and bit-perfect audio on Windows (**WASAPI Exclusive**) is finally rock-solid. Add a big polish pass across lyrics and the library, plus a full native-speaker review of all 17 languages. Still 100% local-first — nothing leaves your machine. --- ### 🎞️ Album covers that move Albums can now come alive. WaveFlow shows **animated covers** behind the now-playing view, Apple-Music-style. They're found automatically by the new **Apple Motion Artwork** plugin — or you can **set your own** motion cover (a local `.mp4`) on any album's page. Prefer to keep them offline? Flip on the optional local cache. Albums without motion art simply show their normal cover, exactly like before.
### 🧩 A plugin store Extend WaveFlow without leaving the app. The new **plugin store** (Settings → Plugins) installs curated plugins in one click, each verified before it lands. This release ships two official plugins — **Web Radio** (30 000+ stations) and **Apple Motion Artwork** — and plugins can now offer their own **settings** panel.
### 👤 Tidier artist pages - **Collapse the biography** with one click, so the discography comes first. - **Split a merged artist** — libraries that joined names with commas (e.g. "Artist A, Artist B") can now be **split apart in place**, no re-tagging your files.
### 🖱️ Right-click, everywhere The full **track menu** — Show in Explorer, Properties, add to playlist or queue, like… — now works when you **right-click the title in the immersive view** or a **row in the play queue**. These spots used to do nothing. ### 🎧 Better audio on Windows A big chunk of this release hardened **WASAPI Exclusive** — bit-perfect output that bypasses the Windows mixer for the cleanest possible sound: - the toggle now reliably turns on **and** off, - the progress bar and lyrics stay perfectly in sync while it's active, - it picks the right format for your device (yes, even 7.1 setups), and - it recovers gracefully if your audio device drops out or resets. ### 🎤 Lyrics - New **"Prefer LRCLIB"** toggle if you'd rather pull online lyrics before embedded ones. - Stronger **synced-lyrics** support — read first, and preserved when you edit. - Static lyrics now **scroll all the way to the end** in the immersive view. - A provider hiccup is no longer remembered as "no lyrics, forever." ### 📚 Library & scanning - **Deep-rescan a single folder** on demand. - The scan progress toast now shows **which folder** it's working through. - Give any **genre its own picture**. - Your **listening history survives** even if you later delete the tracks behind it. - Resetting the app now **safety-backs-up every profile first**, just in case. ### 🎨 Polish & fixes - **Similar artists** no longer show grey placeholder photos. - All **17 languages** got a full native-speaker review pass. - Right-click menus now appear **above** the player bar (no more menus hiding behind it). - The main window **stops creeping bigger** on every launch and remembers where you left it — plus a new **"Reset window position"** action in Settings → Appearance. - Fixes for the GNOME/Wayland title bar, the startup splash screen, and assorted text/layout clipping. --- ## 📦 Recommended install Use your platform's package manager when one is available, so updates keep flowing through the tool you already use. ### Windows ```powershell winget install InstaZDLL.WaveFlow ``` ### Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS / CachyOS ```bash yay -S waveflow-bin # or: paru -S waveflow-bin ``` ### Fedora / RHEL / Rocky / Alma / CentOS Stream ```bash sudo dnf copr enable instazdll/waveflow sudo dnf install waveflow ``` ### Debian / Ubuntu / Mint / Pop!_OS The Debian package is `wave-flow` (kebab-case, required by the Debian naming spec — Tauri bundles it that way from the `WaveFlow` product name). ```bash sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://packages.buildkite.com/instazdll/waveflow/gpgkey \ | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/waveflow.gpg echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/waveflow.gpg] https://packages.buildkite.com/instazdll/waveflow/any/ any main" \ | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/waveflow.list sudo apt update && sudo apt install wave-flow ``` ### macOS No Homebrew cask yet — grab the `.dmg` below. The bundle isn't Apple-signed, so right-click → Open the first time, or run `xattr -cr /Applications/WaveFlow.app` to clear the quarantine flag. ### Standalone download Everything is also available as a raw bundle below — `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.exe`, `.msi`, `.dmg`. --- _Thanks to everyone who tested betas and sent feedback — it shaped a lot of this release. 💚_

# WaveFlow 1.6.6-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** Opt in from **Settings → Diagnostics → Update channel → Beta**. Stable users are unaffected.

This is planned as the **last beta before 1.7.0 stable** — the one remaining piece of the WASAPI saga is the Settings toggle fix below, and confirming it here is what unblocks the stable cut.

## 🎧 WASAPI Exclusive: the Settings toggle fix

1.6.5-beta.1 fixed the actual audio/lyrics/seek-bar recovery — confirmed working by testers. What was still open: after the engine silently rebuilt the output stream on its own (a device flap, or switching output device), the **Settings toggle could be left showing the wrong state**, with no way to tell whether Exclusive mode was actually still engaged short of restarting the app.

The engine now emits an event every time it changes the exclusive/shared mode on its own, and the Settings card listens for it and re-reads the real state — the same pattern already used for sample rate / channel count refresh on track change. ([#405](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/405))

**This is the confirmation this beta needs**: if your setup ever hit the stuck toggle, please trigger a device flap (or switch output device) and check that the Settings toggle now reflects reality afterward.

## ✨ New: custom picture per genre

Genre tiles — in the Library grid and on the genre detail page — showed a fixed generic icon with no way to personalize it. Both now have a pencil overlay to pick a local image, the same pattern already used for artist photos and album covers. ([#424](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/424))

## 🔧 Fixes

- **GNOME/Wayland users: the title bar buttons (minimize, maximize, close) were unresponsive.** This was an upstream bug in the windowing library WaveFlow builds on — the fix is merged upstream but not yet published as an official release, so this build pins directly to that fix commit until the official version ships. ([#427](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/427))
- A rare listener leak in the WASAPI toggle's own refresh code, if Settings was closed at exactly the wrong moment — one extra live listener per occurrence, never freed. Fixed alongside the toggle work above.

## 📝 Notes for testers

- **WASAPI toggle** ([#405](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/405)): this is the one thing standing between this beta and the 1.7.0 stable cut. A confirmation that the Settings toggle now stays accurate through a device flap would be extremely valuable.
- **GNOME/Wayland title bar** ([#427](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/427)): if you're on GNOME + Wayland, a quick check that minimize/maximize/close now respond would help confirm the pin is doing its job.
- Found a rough edge? Please include your OS, the exact steps, and the relevant lines from **Settings → Diagnostics → Open log folder**.
- Betas on this channel are patch-level builds. If this one holds up, **1.7.0 stable is next**.

# WaveFlow 1.6.5-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** Opt in from **Settings → Diagnostics → Update channel → Beta**. Stable users are unaffected.

Picking up right where 1.6.4-beta.1 left off: two more WASAPI Exclusive root causes found and fixed, plus a batch of fixes from tester reports and a new feature — pick your own animated cover for an album.

## 🎧 WASAPI Exclusive: two more pieces of the puzzle

1.6.4-beta.1 fixed the device-reset rebuild loop. Testing that build surfaced two more issues underneath it:

- **Playback position never advanced in Exclusive mode.** Audio played fine, but the app's own position counter didn't move — so the progress bar, lyrics sync, and listening-history stats all had nothing to follow. This is why some testers saw the seek bar and lyrics stop even after the rebuild-loop fix: it was never really about the sound cutting out. ([#405](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/405))
- **The channel mask was guessed instead of read from the device.** An endpoint that only accepts a specific mask rejected the stream with an error that looked like a generic format mismatch. The negotiation now reads the endpoint's actual format and probes fallbacks against known driver quirks. ([#410](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/410), [#411](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/411))

**The Settings toggle getting stuck is still open** ([#405](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/405)) — if you hit it, a fresh log from `Settings → Diagnostics → Open log folder` after reproducing would help a lot.

## ✨ New: manual animated covers

Motion covers previously only came from a metadata plugin's catalogue — a self-released album, a bootleg, or a loop you made yourself had no way in. Album pages now have a **"Pochette animée"** action next to the regular cover picker: pick a local `.mp4` and it takes over from the plugin, permanently, until you clear it. ([#408](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/408))

## 🔧 Fixes

- **Similar artists could go empty for a month over one network hiccup.** A failed Deezer lookup was cached exactly like a genuine "no similar artists" answer, for the same 30-day TTL — so a single bad moment on the network could lock an artist's similar-artists list for weeks. Only a real answer (even an empty one) is cached now; a failure just retries next time. Also fixed the artist-name matching underneath it to tolerate accents and "&" the same way the rest of the app already does. ([#406](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/406), thanks @jo-el414)
- **DLNA kept serving the previous profile after switching.** If you had DLNA running and switched profiles, it kept exposing the old profile's library on the network — and then broke outright once that profile's database closed. Switching profiles now refreshes the DLNA server when it's active. ([#399](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/399))
- **New "deep rescan" action per folder** for the rare case where an external tag editor (e.g. Mp3tag with "preserve modification time" on) edits a genre or embedded picture without changing the file's timestamp — the normal fast rescan has no way to notice that. Look for the refresh icon next to a folder in **Library → Dossiers**; it's slower than a normal rescan on purpose, so it's not the default. ([#366](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/366))
- **Corner overflow on the Home banners, Safari/macOS only.** The glow behind the welcome card and the Wrapped promo card was bleeding past the rounded corners in square patches — a WebKit clipping quirk with blurred elements. ([#414](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/414))
- **Album cover provenance now lives on the album, not the artwork row** — fixes a class of bugs where two albums sharing the same cover image could have one's manual/embedded choice silently overridden by the other's folder cover.
- **Folder covers (`cover.jpg` etc.) replaced on disk are now picked up on the next scan**, instead of only at first import.
- **Listening history now survives a track delete + re-scan** instead of being silently dropped.
- **Truncated track/album titles no longer clip the descenders** of letters like "g" or "y" in some themes.
- **A stale profile pool could briefly cause `PoolClosed` errors** on a fast profile switch during a multi-step command — pool handles are now leased for the duration of the command instead of grabbed fresh each time.

## 📝 Notes for testers

- **WASAPI** ([#405](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/405)): if your setup triggered the old device-reset loop, please confirm the seek bar and lyrics now follow along, and if you ever hit the stuck Settings toggle, a log from that session is exactly what's needed.
- **#366 deep rescan**: if you've had an external tool silently fail to update in WaveFlow before, try the new per-folder deep rescan and let us know if it catches the edit.
- **#414 corner overflow**: macOS testers, a quick look at the Home page corners would confirm the CSS fix actually lands — this box has no Safari to check it against directly.
- Found a rough edge? Please include your OS, the exact steps, and the relevant lines from **Settings → Diagnostics → Open log folder**.
- Betas on this channel are patch-level builds. The next stable release will be **1.7.0**, once WASAPI is confirmed fixed.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.6.4-beta.1...v1.6.5-beta.1

# WaveFlow 1.6.4-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** Opt in from **Settings → Diagnostics → Update channel → Beta**. Stable users are unaffected.

This build is mostly about a bug that has resisted two previous attempts, plus a batch of fixes from tester reports. **If you only test one thing, please test WASAPI Exclusive** — details below.

## 🎧 The big one: WASAPI Exclusive re-init

If your DAC resets its session mid-playback, WASAPI Exclusive could leave the engine in a broken state — playback disrupted, the Settings toggle stuck on, and only a full restart of WaveFlow to get out of it. ([#355](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/355) / [#365](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/365))

The cause turned out to be a **self-sustaining loop**. On a device that resets every time a client grabs it exclusively, our own re-open triggered the next device error, which scheduled another rebuild, which re-opened exclusive again… Each pass ran 300 ms after the previous one finished, so the existing debounce never saw them overlap and let every single one through. Eventually one rebuild opened the device while the previous stream was still settling and collided with `AUDCLNT_E_DEVICE_IN_USE`, and even the shared-mode fallback then failed.

Recovery is now single-owner: one burst of device errors produces exactly **one** rebuild, followed by a short settle window so our own re-open can't re-arm the loop. A genuine later failure (a real unplug) still recovers as before.

**This is hardware-specific and I could not reproduce it locally** — it needs a device that behaves this way. If you hit the bug before, please try this build and check `Settings → Diagnostics → Open log folder` for:

- a **single** `rebuilding cpal output after DeviceNotAvailable` per event (not two or more)
- no `0x8889000A` / `AUDCLNT_E_DEVICE_IN_USE`
- the negotiation staying on your device's real format (e.g. `S24_4LE`) instead of dropping to `S16_LE`

## ✨ New

### Prefer LRCLIB over embedded lyrics
A new toggle under **Settings → Playback** flips the lyrics lookup order: online providers (LRCLIB / Musixmatch) are tried **before** the lyrics embedded in your files. Off by default, so nothing changes unless you want it. ([#378](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/378))

It never loses lyrics: if the online providers have nothing for a track, your file's own embedded or sidecar lyrics are still used. Handy if your rips carry poor-quality or unsynced lyrics you'd rather replace.

## 🔧 Fixes

- **Menus were hidden behind other UI in some themes.** In **Pulse** and **Liquid**, the playback bar covered the bottom of a track's right-click menu, making entries like "Properties" unreachable; in **Studio**, the date header in *Recently Played* painted over the profile menu. Both had the same root cause — the glassy `backdrop-filter` chrome was trapping the menus underneath it. ([#390](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/390), thanks @ukine888)
- **The window no longer reopens "maximized but not maximized".** Closing while maximized used to save the full-screen geometry, so the next launch opened a window at that size without actually being maximized — and it couldn't be restored to its previous size. Only a normally-sized window is remembered now.
- **A network blip no longer marks a track as permanently lyric-less.** If a lyrics provider was unreachable, the failure was cached as "no lyrics exist" and never retried. A provider outage is now told apart from a genuine "nobody has this song", and only the latter is remembered. ([#391](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/391))
- **Animated album covers are fetched once per album** instead of three or four times, since several views were each requesting them independently.

## 🎨 Also worth updating: Apple Motion Artwork plugin v0.3.0

The plugin updates separately from the app — grab it from **Settings → Plugins**. It now finds **noticeably more** animated covers.

It used to accept the first search result blindly, which was often the same-named *single* rather than the album (singles rarely have animated artwork), and it gave up if that one candidate came back empty. It now checks several candidates, ranks them so the actual album wins over a same-named single, and asks Apple for the explicit edition — which frequently has artwork the clean edition lacks.

If animated covers never worked for you, this is the update to try.

## 📝 Notes for testers

- Found a rough edge? Please include your OS, the exact steps, and the relevant lines from **Settings → Diagnostics → Open log folder**.
- Betas on this channel are patch-level builds. The next stable release will be **1.7.0**, once WASAPI is confirmed fixed.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.6.3-beta.2...v1.6.4-beta.1

# WaveFlow 1.6.3-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** Opt in from **Settings → Diagnostics → Update channel → Beta**. Stable users are unaffected. This build follows up `1.6.2-beta.1` with fixes to the plugin platform and a batch of feedback fixes — please keep the feedback coming (open an issue or reply in Discussions).

## 🩹 The big fix: plugins now install on beta builds

`1.6.2-beta.1` shipped the plugin store but the **Apple Motion Artwork** plugin (and any plugin with a `min_app_version`) wrongly showed **"Update required"** and refused to install, even on a fully up-to-date beta.

The compatibility check was reading the compile-time crate version instead of the running app version, so every beta build under-reported itself. It now resolves the real running version, so **plugins install correctly on beta builds**. If you hit "Update required" on `1.6.2-beta.1`, update to this build and try the store again.

*(Still carrying everything from `1.6.2-beta.1`: the in-app plugin store, animated album artwork, the local motion cache, and the plugin-options framework — see that release if you skipped it.)*

## ✨ New

### 🪟 The main window remembers its size and position
WaveFlow now restores the main window's size and position across launches, with no visible jump on startup. A **Reset window position** action lives under **Settings → Appearance** for when the saved bounds end up awkward (a disconnected monitor, a tiny leftover size) — it forgets the saved geometry so the next launch opens at the default.

## 🔧 Fixes

- **Web Radio "local stations" showed the wrong country.** The local-stations shortcut no longer hard-defaults to the US; the preferred country is now scoped per-profile.
- **Curated "similar artists" showed a letter placeholder** instead of the artist's local `artist.jpg` picture when the artist had no Deezer enrichment (offline-first setups). It now prefers the local sidecar, falling back to the Deezer cache.
- **"Read more / show less" was missing on a manually-edited artist bio.** A custom bio now gets a proper short lead-in so the expand toggle appears, matching fetched bios.
- **Lyrics editor footer buttons could be pushed off-screen** after "Save to file…" showed its confirmation path — the footer now wraps/truncates instead of overflowing.

## 📝 Notes for beta testers

- **WASAPI Exclusive re-init on some DACs** ([#355](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/issues/355)) is still being investigated — it's hardware-specific (a device that resets on every exclusive grab). If you hit it, please attach the log lines around `DeviceNotAvailable` / `wasapi exclusive negotiation` so we can tune the flap-storm handling for your device.

# WaveFlow 1.6.2-beta.1

> **Pre-release on the beta channel.** Opt in from **Settings → Diagnostics → Update channel → Beta**. Stable users are unaffected. This build is for testing the new plugin platform — feedback very welcome (open an issue or reply in Discussions).

This beta turns WaveFlow from a player into an **extensible platform**: a real in-app plugin store, animated album artwork, and a generic plugin-options framework.

## ✨ Highlights

### 🧩 In-app plugin store
Browse and install sandboxed plugins straight from **Settings → Plugins**. The curated registry ships one cross-platform WASM binary per plugin, and the app **verifies each download's blake3 against the registry** before loading it — the registry is the trusted pin, so a tampered release can't slip through. Everything a plugin can reach (its HTTP allowlist, storage) is shown before you install and enforced at runtime.

### 🎬 Animated album artwork
Apple Music-style **looping motion covers** now play behind the Now Playing panel and the Immersive view. Install the **Apple Motion Artwork** plugin from the store to turn it on — it resolves Apple's motion artwork for the current album and renders it as a muted, looping video over the static cover.
*(This closes the "Animated artworks" community request — thanks @NielsHoenders!)*

- **Local cache (opt-in):** save the motion clips to disk so they play offline and never re-download. Toggle, current size, and a Clear button live under the plugin's ⚙️ (an app-wide LRU cache, 1 GB cap).
- **H.264 by default:** covers use a universally-playable 1080p H.264 rendition out of the box; a per-plugin option can switch to Apple's 4K HEVC renditions if your system decodes HEVC.

### ⚙️ Plugin options framework
Plugins can now declare **user-configurable options** in their manifest (toggles, dropdowns, text fields). A gear icon appears next to any plugin that has options, opening an inline panel — no more hunting through settings. Values persist per-plugin and reach the plugin at runtime through a sandboxed host API.

## 🔧 Under the hood
- Bumped the wasmtime plugin runtime to 46.
- Fixed WASAPI exclusive-mode re-initialisation on Windows.
- Beta-channel build + version-sync fixes (the app version is synced from the release tag; Windows pre-releases build NSIS-only).

## 📝 Notes for beta testers
- The **Apple Motion Artwork** plugin talks to Apple's public endpoints directly (like yt-dlp does for YouTube) — no WaveFlow server in the middle, and it caches aggressively so a given album is fetched at most once.
- Motion artwork is a metadata plugin: if it can't find a match for an album, the static cover simply stays. Nothing else changes.
- Found a rough edge? Please tell us which album + skin so we can reproduce.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.2-beta.1

## [1.6.1-beta.1](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1-beta.1) (2026-07-04)

> 🧪 **Pre-release build for testing.** This is a beta on the opt-in beta channel — stable users are unaffected and stay on 1.6.0. Opt in under **Settings → Diagnostics → beta updates** to receive it in-app. Please report anything odd.

## 🎧 What's fixed

### WASAPI Exclusive freeze (#322)

On some Windows machines — especially onboard **Realtek** codecs — turning on **WASAPI Exclusive** would freeze playback: the track stayed stopped, and turning the toggle back off took many clicks.

**Root cause:** the device resets itself the moment WaveFlow grabs it in exclusive mode. WaveFlow saw that as "device disappeared" and tried to reconnect — but the previous exclusive connection was still holding the device, so the reconnect failed (`AUDCLNT_E_DEVICE_IN_USE`) and even the fall-back to shared mode couldn't get in. Re-grabbing exclusive re-triggered the reset → an endless loop.

**The fix, two parts:**

- **Release before reconnect** — the old exclusive connection is now fully released before WaveFlow re-opens the device, so the reconnect (and the shared fall-back) can actually get in.
- **Give up gracefully** — if a device keeps resetting on exclusive, WaveFlow now stops fighting it: after a few flaps it drops to shared mode **for that session** and keeps playing, instead of freezing. Toggle exclusive off/on (or switch device) to try again. Your saved preference is untouched — a fresh launch still tries exclusive.

## 🔎 What to test

If WASAPI Exclusive froze for you before, please try this build and check that:

- turning **WASAPI Exclusive on** and pressing play either **plays in exclusive**, or **falls back to shared and keeps playing** — no more freeze;
- if your device can't hold exclusive, playback continues in shared after a few seconds (you can confirm in the log: *"WASAPI exclusive disabled for this session after repeated device flaps"*);
- turning **exclusive off** is immediate — no multi-click.

Logs live at **Settings → Diagnostics → open logs folder** if you want to share what happened.

## 🛠️ Under the hood

- Beta builds now self-report their exact pre-release version, so the in-app updater stops re-offering the same beta after you install it (#348). No effect on stable releases.

---

Thanks for testing 🙏 — feedback on this build directly shapes whether the fix ships in the next stable (1.6.1). Everyone not on the beta channel keeps running 1.6.0 as usual.

## [1.6.0](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/compare/v1.5.1...v1.6.0) (2026-06-29)

## ✨ What's new in v1.6.0

**WaveFlow 1.6.0 — radio & robustness.** The Web Radio plugin that shipped as a tech demo in 1.5.0 is now a full listening surface: live now-playing, artwork, lyrics, favorites, country browsing, and a fully offline station catalogue. Under the hood, the audio engine gained four robustness upgrades, the fullscreen experience was rebuilt into one immersive panel, and the first library scan is now **~4× faster**. Still 100% local-first — nothing leaves your machine.

---

### 📻 Web Radio, fully grown (#289)

From "it plays a stream" to a real listening experience:

- **Live now-playing** — ICY stream titles become the current song, with the station identity (name · genre/country) on its own line, everywhere: PlayerBar, immersive view, mini-player.
- **Album artwork** — the `Artist – Title` resolves a cover from Deezer and replaces the station favicon. A stale fetch can never overwrite a track that already moved on.
- **Lyrics per song** — pulled live from LRCLIB as each track changes, rendered statically (a stream has no timeline to sync to).
- **Favorites** — one ★ on the PlayerBar, mini-player and immersive view, shared across all three so they never drift. Per profile.
- **Browse by country** — alongside the existing genre / top / search filters.
- **Works offline** — download a snapshot of the ~35 000-station directory (Settings → Data) and search it with zero network. Same queries, no connection. Used automatically in offline or local-first mode.
- **Mini-player catch-up** — a mini-player opened mid-stream now shows the live station, not a stale library track.

![Web Radio — live now-playing, favorites, country browse](https://github.com/InstaZDLL/WaveFlow/raw/main/docs/screenshots/web-radio.png)

### 🎚️ Audio robustness

Four engine upgrades focused on never dropping or mangling a sample:

- **Sharper DSD → PCM** — choose the conversion quality (256 / 1024 / 2048 taps) in Settings → Playback. More taps = cleaner sound at a higher CPU cost. DSD only.
- **Smoother network playback** — files on a remote/SMB share are loaded fully into RAM (up to 512 MiB) and decoded from memory, so high-latency links no longer cause stutter.
- **Proper surround downmix** — 5.1 / 6.1 / 7.1 and beyond now fold down to stereo correctly (ITU-R BS.775) instead of silently dropping channels.
- **Clip protection** — the final stage guards the DAC against hard clipping while leaving a clean stream untouched (bit-perfect output preserved).

### 🖼️ Immersive view — one fullscreen panel (#328)

The old "fullscreen now-playing" and "fullscreen lyrics" overlays are now a single immersive view:

- **Merged mode** (opt-in) — cover + controls on the left, a tabbed panel on the right that flips between **Lyrics** and **Queue**, so you can manage what's next without leaving.
- **Classic mode** (default) — the familiar now-playing view, with a one-tap jump to fullscreen lyrics. Unchanged.
- **Native OS fullscreen** (opt-in) — a true borderless, Spotify-style takeover.

Both are per-profile (Settings → Appearance). Narrow windows fall back to classic automatically.

### 🔤 Scrolling long titles

Titles that don't fit now glide back and forth instead of being cut off, in the PlayerBar and immersive view. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and you can turn it off in Settings → Appearance.

### 🔎 Smarter search & stats

- **Sectioned search (#321)** — the top-bar dropdown now splits results into **Artists**, **Albums** and **Titles**, each linking straight to its detail view.
- **Top genres (#324)** — a new Statistics card ranking your genres by listening time, included in the JSON export.
- **Hideable KPIs (#324)** — hide any stat card you don't care about (Settings → Appearance), saved per profile.

### 👤 Artist & metadata

- **Offline artist overrides (#323)** — write your own bio and pick your own "similar artists" per artist. They work fully offline and survive every enrichment pass. Edit from Artist Detail → "Edit info".
- **TheAudioDB bios** — pick TheAudioDB (multi-language) instead of Last.fm as your bio source in Settings → Integrations.

### 🧪 Beta channel
